A_accumulation_order.perturbation: FP32 summation order of identical per-sequence contributions
A_accumulation_order.fixed: sequences, activations, routing, contributions, act-order, groups, windows
A_accumulation_order.limitation: one seed, 5 deterministic orders, one hardware/software stack

B_AOF.perturbation: BF16 calibration activations from alternative batch groupings; routing R_O and act-order P_O frozen

hessian_metric.kind: trace-normalized rel. diff vs OO, median per grouping
hessian_metric.note: AOF Hessians are bitwise the AO Hessians

B_AOF.limitation: act-order and group membership fixed jointly; one seed

C_AO.perturbation: as B, act-order and groups follow each Hessian

hessian_metric.kind: trace-normalized rel. diff vs OO, median per grouping

D_natural_grouping_seed0.perturbation: batch grouping: activations, routing, Hessians, act-order, weights

hessian_metric.kind: trace-normalized rel. diff vs OO, median per grouping

D_natural_grouping_seed0.limitation: one seed; ORIGINAL extraction is a different policy and is not one of the 5 draws

D3_natural_grouping_3seeds.limitation: 3 allocation seeds; groupings nested, not crossed

statistic_types: FR_sd / FC_sd = SD (ddof 1) of one strategy's PPL over the variants; delta_sd = SD of the paired FC-FR difference. Different interventions; SDs are NOT additive and are not decomposed.
